analysis.scope: Derive repeatable teaching and visual practices from the exact three published handcrafted reference movies.
analysis.method: Complete narration read; visual inspection of every encoded scene sheet including early/middle/late beats, change peaks, long holds, transitions and end states; 17 additional native 1920x1080 encoded frames; selected executable computational film source read. This is not continuous playback with sound, independent factual certification, or publication approval.

principles.instruction: Choose one concrete, small worked example whose state persists across the central explanation. Compute the displayed quantities from the same data that drives the picture. Assert exact numerical results and important invariants in the authoring source.

references.observed: The same Birds and sing states become query/key geometry and two explicit dot products; the longer off-angle key beats the short aligned key.
Weighted corpus tiles physically merge while a shared computation updates pair counts, the ordered merge list and position total 30 to 23 to 16 to 11.
The 16-block pool, request ownership and block table persist as logical position 5 maps through logical block 1 and slot 1 to physical block 2.

principles.why: Learners can check the mechanism and compare states without decoding a fresh example at every cut. Arithmetic errors cannot hide behind attractive labels.

principles.instruction: Make motion perform the operation being taught: merge, route, add, allocate, copy, reject or accumulate. Name what changes and what observable result follows. Camera movement, glow, generic particles and sequential card reveals do not substitute for a mechanism.

references.observed: The two value vectors scale by shares and add tip to tail to the contextual output point.
A branch's shared partial block moves to a free location, its block table changes, both ownership counts update, and separate appends preserve each future.
Characters open into their actual UTF-8 bytes; independent decoding loses the characters; gathering the bytes reconstructs the text.

principles.why: Removing the animation would remove explanatory information rather than only decoration.

principles.instruction: At a conceptual hinge, ask for a prediction, change one meaningful input or assumption, retain the rest of the state, then show the result and its cause. Include a failure case or limiting case that distinguishes the mechanism from a plausible wrong rule.

references.observed: Changing a score moves the output toward its value; making both values equal leaves the output fixed despite changing shares and makes the score gradient zero.
Adding only rainb to the vocabulary makes greedy longest-match choose it and lose the whole rainbow word, although rain plus continuation bow was valid.
Lowering only the whole-piece probability from .30 to .01 flips the best complete path to .15 times .10, disproving a longest-piece rule.
Paged and continuous attention give the same computed output; reading one invalid sentinel slot changes the output drastically.

principles.why: A viewer learns to predict behavior and reject a misconception instead of remembering an attractive demonstration.

principles.instruction: Introduce a mathematical expression through a picture or operation, then connect each symbol, axis, unit and dimension to that picture. Keep the numerical example and notation consistent when changing representation.

references.observed: Individual attention becomes Q times K transpose, scaled row softmax, then V; unequal matrix shapes reveal the missing transpose and wrong normalization axis.
Keys and values, layers and KV heads occupy independent slab axes and correspond to 2 x 32 x 8 x 128 x 2 bytes, producing 128 KiB per token.
Equal fixed text spans at three and four characters per token show why a one-third rate increase gives a one-quarter position decrease.

principles.why: The formula becomes a compact account of something the viewer already understands.

principles.instruction: Give entities stable colors, names and positions. Use hierarchy and generous spacing to focus one question at a time. Use 3D only when its axes, volume or viewpoint teach a real property; choose 2D when it makes the relationship clearer.

references.observed: Birds is blue and sing teal; their word identities remain visible as the lesson moves into vectors and attention.
3D cache volume grows with token count while layer and KV-head axes retain meaning and a readable formula remains available.
Four colored invented IDs point directly to matching colored rows, so color encodes an association rather than atmosphere.

principles.why: The viewer can track identity across transformations. Copying the dark palette, serif headings or glow alone does not transfer this benefit.

principles.instruction: Teach operational constraints by running the wrong approach visibly, showing the failure on concrete state, then repairing it. Preserve the consequences and tradeoffs after the repair.

references.observed: Shared reads are safe, competing appends overwrite one branch's key/value, and copy-on-write gives each branch a private partial block; full blocks can remain shared.
A tokenizer ID swap quietly selects the wrong trained row; moving only input rows leaves the separate output table wrong; moving all indexed state together repairs the renumbering.
An allocation fails with the tables unchanged, then alternative recompute and CPU-swap paths recover capacity while showing compute versus link-bandwidth costs.

principles.why: Constraints have causal meaning and lead to a decision a learner can make.

principles.instruction: Author visual changes at measured spoken phrases. Make the relevant object readable when its claim is spoken, clear outgoing content before new content must be read, and leave purposeful time to inspect arithmetic or answer a prediction. Judge holds in context. Preserve teaching completeness before optimizing duration.

references.observed: The new vocabulary item and a held prediction precede the greedy matcher failure.
The viewer receives new block-size and occupancy questions, then the pool and formula resolve their answers in stages.

principles.why: Speech and visuals become one explanation rather than competing reading tracks. Reference films are roughly 21 to 25 minutes, so their quality is not a short runtime rule.

principles.instruction: Distinguish invented examples, exact arithmetic, sourced historical measurements and workload-dependent claims at the moment each matters. Show toy-to-scale reasoning without presenting an illustrative timing or ratio as a benchmark. State the assumptions that change the result.

references.observed: The count-ratio training score is labeled a classroom proxy based on a reconstruction, with BERT's exact training recipe unpublished.
Fixed vocabulary memory arithmetic is separated from language-dependent sequence savings and a historical whole-tokenizer comparison.
Packing, scheduling, KV-head count, precision and dropping positions are compared as different levers; architecture changes and approximation limits remain visible.
Running max, denominator and numerator reproduce the full-row result while the lesson separates temporary attention traffic from persistent KV-cache capacity.

principles.why: Visual confidence does not become scientific overclaiming.

principles.instruction: End the central lesson with a new input or state that requires the learned mechanism. Hold the question, show the computed answer and explain why it follows. Return to the opening problem and use the earned result to connect to the next lesson. A recap or checklist alone is not the payoff.

references.observed: A new state yields q=[2.5,3.5], new scores and shares, and a different output [1.3,1.7] plotted against the prior output.
With block size 32 the learner sizes A/B, releases A, adds C, maps position 40 to physical block 11, then diagnoses a full-pool byte-budget problem.
A snow/snowy/show corpus yields 38 to 29 positions; snowball tests a new greedy dead end; new Unigram probabilities make a two-piece path beat a one-piece path.

principles.why: The viewer demonstrates a capability instead of merely seeing a list of ideas covered.

principles.instruction: Review the exact encoded movie, not just the source or poster. Cover every authored scene and inspect early/middle/late narrative states, transitions, long holds and the ending. Inspect important frames at native resolution and intended playback size. Record exact source/movie hashes and specific scene reasons. Keep sampled frame review, automated decode/layout checks, full-speed listening and publication approval distinct.

references.observed: A native transition frame exposes multiple intermediate digits from motion blur, which a polished held frame does not reveal.
A dark crossfade is a readability candidate; the encoded decoder separately reports no unexplained blank runs, so the still alone does not establish a persistent defect.

principles.why: Technical success and a few strong stills cannot certify pacing, listening quality or every scene's teaching value.

antiPatterns: Applying the reference color palette, serif font, glow or 3D camera to generic boxes and calling the result equivalent.
A single attractive opening followed by static prose cards or an unearned checklist ending.
Numerical labels and geometric quantities authored independently so they can disagree.
Reusing the same board layout for topics with different explanatory structures.
Showing a result before the operation or spoken setup that makes it intelligible.
Deleting hard limits, counterexamples, training/serving distinctions or transfer exercises to make a video shorter.
Calling sampled encoded frames a complete human watch with sound or independent factual certification.
Treating an automated score, decode pass, or source-level assertion as aesthetic approval.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Attention native encoded frame 816.4s, learn scene, frames/sample-0216.png
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Multiple intermediate percentage and decimal glyphs are visible during a state transition. This may be intentional temporal motion blur; the reviewed still does not establish persistence or audibility mismatch.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Use bounded transition duration, hold a crisp final numerical state, and inspect numerical changes during actual playback before accepting equivalent effects elsewhere.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Attention native encoded frame 847.9s, cost scene, frames/sample-0228.png
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: The previous grid and incoming formula are both dim in the sampled crossfade. Existing encoded decodedFrameAudit.passed is true and unexplainedBlankRuns is empty.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Review the surrounding transition at speed and prefer a retained readable anchor when the narration still relies on a quantity. Do not turn a single dark transition frame into an invented persistent blocker.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Tokenization wordpiece-score, lookup and economics scene sheets; KV Cache size and shrink sheets
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Some necessary source qualifiers, numeric tables and limitations are smaller than the central diagram. Desktop native frames remain readable for the inspected examples; mobile playback and every qualifier's dwell were not tested here.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: At the intended player size, check that necessary symbols, scope labels and units remain readable for their required duration. Keep a qualifier spoken or visually central when it controls the claim.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.evidence: Tokenization hook and the three closing scenes
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: Tokenization opens with the rhetorical sentence that the model never reads the user's sentence, and closings include recap labels. Their utility comes from the following transformations and prior computed exercises, not those phrases or summary cards alone.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Prefer a direct mechanism or concrete question in new scripts, and preserve the prior transfer demonstration if using a short recap.

referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.observation: No continuous full-speed playback with sound, no human listening assessment, no Mac AVFoundation gate, no mobile player inspection, and no independent external fact audit were performed by this reviewer.
referenceWeaknessesAndLimits.recommendation: Retain those gates explicitly. This analysis provides transferable design evidence and complete sampled scene coverage, not a new publication decision.

reviewLimits: Visual evidence is sampled from encoded movies and hashed at the inspected image artifact paths. It does not establish review of every movie frame.
The corpus review does not establish a continuous full-speed watch with sound. Narration scripts were read where the receipt says so; audio performance was not universally assessed.
No independent comprehensive factual-certification pass is claimed.
Tracks, priorities, grades, and recommendations are reviewer judgments, not objective scores.
Publication approval is false for every entry. This report records evidence and review judgments; it does not authorize release or replacement.
Current source hashes are recorded separately from the published movie bytes and the review-time bindings. Source drift does not rewrite what the published movie review inspected.

sceneReviews.purpose: Choose relevant evidence.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Four support notes and two query words define a top-two prediction.
sceneReviews.strength: The question can be answered by the viewer before machinery arrives.
sceneReviews.defect: A scan pointer highlights an irrelevant note near the end of the opening.
sceneReviews.remedy: Distinguish the scan cursor from the selected-answer highlight.

sceneReviews.purpose: Separate identity from position.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Array growth copies references and front insertion shifts positions while IDs remain fixed.
sceneReviews.strength: Physical movement earns the linear-work claim.
sceneReviews.defect: Amortized append is verbal after one resize.
sceneReviews.remedy: Add a quiet copy-work counter across several cheap appends.

sceneReviews.purpose: Establish baseline work.
sceneReviews.mechanism: All four notes are read and receive binary term scores.
sceneReviews.strength: Zero relevance still costs a read.
sceneReviews.defect: Sampled middle states hold the first note before all scores resolve.
sceneReviews.remedy: Check continuous pacing and let each word hit deposit its score.

sceneReviews.purpose: Invert the lookup direction.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Each owned message ID moves from its words into word-key postings.
sceneReviews.strength: The direction change is visible and preserves provenance.
sceneReviews.defect: Collision resolution remains a narration statement.
sceneReviews.remedy: Add two colliding keys sharing a bucket and compare their original strings.

sceneReviews.purpose: Separate frequency from set membership.
sceneReviews.mechanism: A second twice leaves M0 present once but increments frequency.
sceneReviews.strength: One changed occurrence produces the intended counterexample.
sceneReviews.defect: The frequency and membership destinations are spatially separate.
sceneReviews.remedy: Split the same occurrence into its two distinct effects.

sceneReviews.purpose: Compute binary query relevance.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Posting IDs visit owned counters; charged adds three and twice adds two.
sceneReviews.strength: Visited postings and scores are counted separately.
sceneReviews.defect: The score dictionary layout looks like a dense array.
sceneReviews.remedy: Retain an explicit key-to-counter binding.

sceneReviews.purpose: Retain bounded winners.
sceneReviews.mechanism: A weaker root is replaced, tied IDs repair heap order, and output sorts strongest first.
sceneReviews.strength: The eviction prediction and separate output order explain partial order.
sceneReviews.defect: Two nodes cannot demonstrate unsorted sibling relationships.
sceneReviews.remedy: Use a brief third-child ghost only if the partial-order misconception needs a deeper follow-up.

sceneReviews.purpose: Choose a FIFO structure.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Deque head movement is compared with list reference shifts.
sceneReviews.strength: The same returned job has visibly different work.
sceneReviews.defect: The deque head marker could be more prominent.
sceneReviews.remedy: Keep the head anchored until the removal is complete.

sceneReviews.purpose: Preserve job ownership and bounded admission.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Out-of-order completion keeps IDs; a ring admits only after a claim; a stale empty check reserves nothing.
sceneReviews.strength: Actual counterexamples earn the synchronization rule.
sceneReviews.defect: Three mechanisms share one authored scene.
sceneReviews.remedy: Carry the same job marker through the three arrangements to reduce reset cost.

sceneReviews.purpose: Restrict a category subtree.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Billing descendants are collected while Access remains outside.
sceneReviews.strength: A category tree is explicitly distinguished from an ordered search tree.
sceneReviews.defect: This branch is an isolated detour from the active query.
sceneReviews.remedy: Show the collected IDs becoming the actual candidate filter.

sceneReviews.purpose: Avoid repeated graph discovery.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Queue and discovered set separate work from membership and reject repeated neighbors.
sceneReviews.strength: A queued duplicate and back edge both have visible consequences.
sceneReviews.defect: Active-node and discovered-node colors are close.
sceneReviews.remedy: Use distinct motion and shape for active expansion.

sceneReviews.purpose: Share a prefix traversal.
sceneReviews.mechanism: One-symbol edges lead through charg, then return three marked complete words.
sceneReviews.strength: Returned completions are counted as additional work.
sceneReviews.defect: The terms do not visibly rejoin their postings.
sceneReviews.remedy: Let one completed term open its existing posting route.

sceneReviews.purpose: Prevent shared mutation.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Aliases point at one mutable list, then replay the mutation on a request-owned copy of an immutable tuple.
sceneReviews.strength: Ownership geometry physically explains the bug and repair.
sceneReviews.defect: The initial tuple-to-mutable-list counterexample changes representation abruptly.
sceneReviews.remedy: Label the intentionally broken cache representation before replay.

sceneReviews.purpose: Apply permission before top-k.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Global selection followed by filtering leaves one result; filtering first fills both permitted slots.
sceneReviews.strength: The changed operation order has a concrete output difference.
sceneReviews.defect: The second path arrives as a fresh layout.
sceneReviews.remedy: Replay the same candidates through a movable filter boundary.

sceneReviews.purpose: Invalidate stale rankings coherently.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Editing M2 removes both postings, publishes version eight and misses the version-seven cache key.
sceneReviews.strength: The changed corpus produces a changed pair of winners.
sceneReviews.defect: Several transitions hide intermediate data under text labels.
sceneReviews.remedy: Keep M2 and its removed posting references visible in a quiet history lane.

sceneReviews.purpose: Resolve the original question after an edit.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Current postings yield scores two and one; winners open their actual text.
sceneReviews.strength: The ending returns to the user-facing evidence with current versions.
sceneReviews.defect: It resolves a prior edit rather than asking a fresh learner transfer.
sceneReviews.remedy: Add a brief new permission or query-word prediction using the same corpus.

lessons.limits: Sampled encoded visual/narration review. Personally reviewed scene contacts and listed native frames; no claim of every-frame motion/audio review or a human full-speed watch with sound.

lessons.title: How Work Grows with the Input

strengths: Same engineering-search setting connects scan, ordering, top-k, pair work, attention and a cap/recall counterexample.
Binary interval, array-reference shifts, min-heap eviction, upper-triangle pair count and 2x2 grouped attention cells genuinely show operations.
Toy counts and synthetic timings are clearly qualified; scoring and selection costs stay separate.
gaps: The growth scene states expected/worst/amortized labels without constructing a collision or append history.
The ending returns to six labeled rows instead of asking for and resolving one new workload decision.
Several native labels and paired panels are small/low-emphasis relative to unused frame area.
reviewSummary.possibleCoreCoverageGap: The article has prefix/tries/radix work models that the narration never develops. Confirm whether a complete-topic video needs a brief visible trie walk or a named prerequisite/series part.

lessons.publicationRecommendation: No new POST certification; full teaching, independent factual and human-watch gates must be met before replacement.

referenceComparison.possibleCoreCoverageGap: The article has prefix/tries/radix work models that the narration never develops. Confirm whether a complete-topic video needs a brief visible trie walk or a named prerequisite/series part.

blockers.issue: Hash expected versus worst case and amortized append remain labeled claims, not a visible cost model.
blockers.remedy: Route the same keys into buckets, force collisions, then replay several appends with an explicit cumulative-copy counter before generalizing.

blockers.issue: A roughly41-second six-row ledger repeats categories and has no new visual prediction or concrete result.
blockers.remedy: Give a new candidate/dimension/cap case, let the viewer choose which stage to change, then recompute both work and recall on the existing evidence.

improvement.concept: Carry one query through a work meter: physically count inspections, halve a search interval, and grow pair tiles. Finish by choosing a cap that fits a visible budget without silently losing the needed document.
improvement.pilotSuitability: Strong bounded pilot: preserve useful existing mechanisms and improve construction/payoff instead of adding stage effects.

sceneReviews.purpose: Create the scale question from4 versus50,000 authorized passages.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Sequentially highlighted rows and an inspection counter.
sceneReviews.strength: Concrete search context and invariant candidate identities.
sceneReviews.defect: The large-corpus scale is chiefly a label beside the same four-row drawing.
sceneReviews.remedy: Let the four visible rows expand into a spatial corpus and carry one inspected row into the work counter.

sceneReviews.purpose: Name the repeated operation and bounded-row assumption.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Row highlights increment visits, then the count maps to W_scan=n.
sceneReviews.strength: Counter corresponds to an inspectable loop.
sceneReviews.defect: Later row-length/timer qualification is mostly subtitle changes over a completed counter.
sceneReviews.remedy: Expand one passage into words when introducing the second input, while leaving the candidate counter fixed.

sceneReviews.purpose: Distinguish tight, expected, worst-case and amortized bounds.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Numeric growth bars followed by labeled bound rows.
sceneReviews.strength: Scan and sort are kept in separate cost rows.
sceneReviews.defect: Expected/worst/amortized behavior has no constructed input history or collision.
sceneReviews.remedy: Build bucket collisions and a resizing array cumulatively, so each bound names a demonstrated count.

sceneReviews.purpose: Show halving and sorted-array insertion maintenance.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Midpoint highlight narrows active interval; insertion visibly shifts later references.
sceneReviews.strength: Objects retain ID and the extra insertion bill is physically explained.
sceneReviews.defect: A four-element example makes the asymptotic payoff visually modest.
sceneReviews.remedy: Add a second-scale halving replay with the same target identity and a shared comparison axis.

sceneReviews.purpose: Separate nd scoring from bounded-heap selection.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Scored IDs feed a min-heap; weaker root is evicted and rejected candidate stays outside.
sceneReviews.strength: Heap ownership and rejection explain the selection rule.
sceneReviews.defect: The 38.4M coordinate-work figure is a product label rather than a constructed coordinate comparison.
sceneReviews.remedy: Grow one n-by-d product tile before scaling to the large count, then leave that bill fixed while k changes.

sceneReviews.purpose: Explain unordered pair growth.
sceneReviews.mechanism: Upper triangle fills, then expands from8 to16 items; bidirectional count contrasts with unique pairs.

lessons.reviewSummary: The residual-to-radius-to-interval chain and fixed-threshold drift intervention approach the reference standard. editorialAssessment.referenceComparison: The residual-to-radius-to-interval chain and fixed-threshold drift intervention approach the reference standard. Replace the ornamental permutation with an exhaustive held-out-identity construction that visibly earns 8/10 coverage, and synchronize the selected-score movement into the interval.
blockers: The exchangeability scene keeps NEW at score 4.5 and sorted rank eight through every shuffle; permutation of list order does not demonstrate that the future identity is equally likely to occupy each rank.

The current article additionally covers classification/APS, subgroup coverage and decision loss. The delivered regression introduction should name its narrower scope and link those companion mechanisms.

improvement.concept: Use ten distinct score cards and successively designate each card as the future example. Calibrate on the other nine, select the eighth calibration score, and mark exactly which eight held-out positions are covered. Then transport the selected radius onto the new prediction axis and end with a target that requires an unavailable finite rank.

lessons.title: Why a Winning Score Can Fade on New Data
lessons.reviewSummary: Preserve the computed search-radius curve and failed checkerboard separator. Rebuild the central sampling and candidate-selection story with persistent tickets and predictors, so the learner sees why simultaneous coverage costs more before receiving a formula. The reference films physically explain the result and finish with a new case; this film mainly labels those requirements.
lessons.publicationRecommendation: No new POST certification; full teaching, independent factual and human-watch gates must be met before replacement.

editorialAssessment.referenceComparison: Preserve the computed search-radius curve and failed checkerboard separator. Rebuild the central sampling and candidate-selection story with persistent tickets and predictors, so the learner sees why simultaneous coverage costs more before receiving a formula. The reference films physically explain the result and finish with a new case; this film mainly labels those requirements.
blockers: The opening promises a benchmark winner facing a second exam, but no fresh ticket outcomes or release decision are resolved.
The fixed-predictor and uniform bounds appear without a visual repeated-sample or simultaneous-failure mechanism; the excess-risk chain uses abstract boxes.

The current article also teaches Sauer-Shelah, Rademacher complexity, interpolation and sufficient sample counts. The delivered film covers only the introductory subset and should name that boundary or add companions.

improvement.concept: Keep one 40-ticket benchmark and a visible frozen candidate pool. Draw repeated fresh samples, compare a prespecified predictor with the selected winner, build simultaneous coverage from per-candidate failures, then freeze the winner and run a genuinely fresh second exam. Use a second short film for richer capacity and interpolation examples.

editorialAssessment.publicationRecommendation: No new POST certification; full teaching, independent factual and human-watch gates must be met before replacement.

sceneReviews.remedy: Place two predictors on a common risk axis with their empirical and population positions and move both epsilon gaps physically.

lessons.title: One Model Across Several GPUs
lessons.reviewSummary: The film genuinely computes column and row shards, a nonlinear counterexample, complementary projections and pipeline bubbles. Preserve that strong tensor-parallel core, then scope the article context/expert parallelism and deployment-layout mechanisms explicitly.

editorialAssessment.overall: The film genuinely computes column and row shards, a nonlinear counterexample, complementary projections and pipeline bubbles. Preserve that strong tensor-parallel core, then scope the article context/expert parallelism and deployment-layout mechanisms explicitly.
editorialAssessment.referenceComparison: The same input and matrix survive multiple splits. Complete slices versus partial sums physically determine whether concatenation or reduction is required, and the wrong-order ReLU counterexample changes the result. The closing generic chain is weaker than the worked arithmetic.
editorialAssessment.coreCoverage: Tensor/column/row composition, collective output contracts, pipeline fill/drain and per-device memory are covered. Article context parallel Ring/Ulysses, decode-context sharding, expert routing, KV-head replication and TP/DP/disaggregated serving trade-offs are not developed by this narration.

lessons.title: Learning from Preferred Answers
lessons.reviewSummary: DPO margin, probability, loss, and two-logit updates have meaningful computed state, and the ending tests a short-answer shortcut. Fix the stable false equal-odds label, then add the PPO mechanism and third-response probability-mass example, or split the named article promise.

editorialAssessment.overall: DPO margin, probability, loss, and two-logit updates have meaningful computed state, and the ending tests a short-answer shortcut. Fix the stable false equal-odds label, then add the PPO mechanism and third-response probability-mass example, or split the named article promise.
editorialAssessment.referenceComparison: Content identity survives card reordering, and gradient updates are computed. The formula introduction uses compact text instead of tokens physically accumulating into sequence log-probability. The PPO loop uses boxes and labels rather than explaining policy-ratio clipping.
editorialAssessment.coreCoverage: The complete script teaches fixed-context pairs, policy/reference log-ratios, the sigmoid and beta, negative-log loss, the two-logit gradient, offline versus fresh-rollout loops, and a length-controlled held-out audit. The article’s PPO clipping, four roles, token reward shaping, systems cost, chosen probability falling while the DPO margin rises, and related methods need new coverage or a named series. The core PPO mechanism needs an explicit scope decision.

materialFindings.finding: At q = 0.50, βm = 0.00, and loss 0.693, the caption says chosen above even odds. This stable equal-odds state is falsely classified.
materialFindings.remedy: Use a three-way below/equal/above label consistent with display precision and check the boundary.

pilotConcept.title: One pair, three outcomes, and a real preference-boundary test
pilotConcept.change: Carry the route answers’ token log-probabilities into the DPO margin. Add an uncompared third answer to show that the margin can improve while the chosen answer’s absolute probability falls. Separately construct PPO clipping from motion in the old/new policy ratio.

sceneReviews.remedy: Keep this complete derivation. Reuse its numerical output in any additional architecture scene.

sceneReviews.remedy: Keep the controlled intervention; if extending to QK normalization, label exactly which head/features the new normalizer reduces.

sceneReviews.mechanism: Track the same selected coordinate through LN, a computed branch, and residual addition in Pre-LN and Post-LN, then compare whole vectors after two blocks.
sceneReviews.finding: The branch and skip ownership is physically traceable. Full sheets show why normalization before the branch differs from normalization after the sum, with actual values rather than a slogan. Article-specific extra placements remain unworked.
sceneReviews.remedy: Extend the existing graph with branch-output normalization and one matched residual scaling/init example. Keep the same inputs and branch function so only placement changes.

sceneReviews.mechanism: Separate the direct identity contribution from the residual branch Jacobian and construct a branch contribution that cancels the direct probe.
sceneReviews.finding: The direct and opposing branch vectors visibly sum to zero. The film correctly explains that an available identity route does not guarantee a nonzero total gradient. Full-sheet review found this counterexample unusually useful.
sceneReviews.remedy: Preserve this counterexample and show which new normalization placements retain the direct route.

sceneReviews.mechanism: Compare RMS normalization and LayerNorm under a common offset on the same four-feature vector.
sceneReviews.finding: RMSNorm preserves a nonzero mean and changes under the common shift, while the centered LN output stays fixed. Narration separates arithmetic savings from whole-kernel hardware performance claims.
sceneReviews.remedy: Keep the controlled offset comparison. A QK extension should distinguish removing scale variation from changing vector direction and attention temperature.

sceneReviews.finding: All rounded entries collapse to 10000 and their normalized output becomes zero; wider accumulation cannot reconstruct discarded differences. The concrete ending explains why kernel correctness needs a reference on the same rounded inputs.
sceneReviews.remedy: Preserve this payoff and its same-input reference rule. New architecture material should precede it rather than displace it.
